name: Cal Hampton
text: Paranoid and mostly at home, tuned in to radio chatter and conspiracy theories.
facts: Jason's friend and associate.
He feels safest at home, with a few beers and the Coast Guard's radio traffic playing in the background.
He is content with a low-key life near the bottom of the ladder, while Jason has bigger plans.

faq.q: Who is Cal Hampton in GTA 6?
faq.a: Cal is Jason Duval's friend. He prefers to stay home, listening in on Coast Guard radio and happy with a quiet life.

name: Boobie Ike
text: Has real estate, a strip club and a recording studio to his name.
facts: A Vice City legend who came up on the street.
He turned that past into a legitimate business empire: real estate, a strip club and a recording studio.
He is in business with Dre'Quan Priest on the record label Only Raw Records.
Friendly and easygoing, right up until it is time to talk business.

faq.q: Who is Boobie Ike in GTA 6?
faq.a: Boobie Ike is a Vice City businessman with real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and a partner in the label Only Raw Records.

text: Works with Boobie Ike at the label Only Raw Records.
facts: Always more of a hustler than a gangster.

He has been booking acts into Boobie Ike's strip club.

faq.q: Who is Dre'Quan Priest in GTA 6?
faq.a: Dre'Quan is a hustler turned music man who works with Boobie Ike at Only Raw Records and signed the rap duo Real Dimez.

name: Real Dimez
text: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends turned rap and social media act, signed to Only Raw Records.
facts: A duo: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school.
Their history includes shaking down local dealers, rapping, and building a following on social media.
They had a viral hit, DWNPLY, about five years ago.
They are now signed to Only Raw Records, Dre'Quan Priest's label.

faq.q: Who are Real Dimez in GTA 6?
faq.a: Real Dimez are Bae-Luxe and Roxy, a rap duo who have been friends since high school. They had a viral hit years ago and are now signed to Only Raw Records.

name: Raul Bautista
text: A veteran who runs a heist crew and is always recruiting for it.
facts: A seasoned bank robber.
He is always on the lookout for new talent for his crew.
His recklessness keeps raising the stakes, so the people working with him have to go all in or get out.

faq.q: Who is Raul Bautista in GTA 6?
faq.a: Raul is a veteran bank robber who is always recruiting, and whose recklessness keeps raising the stakes for his crew.

name: Brian Heder
text: A long-time drug runner with a boat yard, who lets Jason live on one of his properties.
facts: An old-school drug runner from the heyday of smuggling in the Keys, and still at it.
He runs a boat yard, which he uses to move product.
He is married to his third wife, Lori.
He lets Jason live rent-free in one of his properties, in return for help with shakedowns.

faq.q: Who is Brian Heder in GTA 6?
faq.a: Brian is a veteran drug runner in the Leonida Keys with a boat yard. He is Jason Duval's landlord.
